snippet.title: THÁI LAN KHÔNG MỜI ĐT VIỆT NAM, BẤT NGỜ CHỌN BRUNEI HẠNG 196 FIFA DỰ KING'S CUP
snippet.description:
Thái Lan không mời ĐT Việt Nam, bất ngờ chọn Brunei hạng 196 FIFA dự King's Cup. Sau khi đối thủ mạnh Bahrain bất ngờ tuyên bố rút lui khỏi King’s Cup 2026, ai cũng hóng người Thái sẽ mời một cái tên sừng sỏ cỡ ĐT Việt Nam để tạo nên trận cầu rực lửa.
Nhưng không! Thái Lan  vừa khiến cả Đông Nam Á phải "ngã ngửa" khi chốt hạ phương án thay thế mang tên Brunei! và quyết định này ngay lập tức thổi bùng lên một đại hội tranh cãi trên mạng xã hội.
Ai cũng biết Brunei là đội yếu xếp hạng 196 Fifa xưa nay vốn bị xem là "kho điểm" của khu vực. Việc ngó lơ các đội mạnh để chọn một đối thủ quá chênh lệch khiến giải đấu mất sạch tính căng thẳng. Dân mạng không ngần ngại mỉa mai: Phải chăng người Thái đang sợ mất mặt, cố tình tìm một "quân xanh lót đường" để cầm chắc chiếc cúp trên sân nhà?
Dù bóng đá luôn tiềm ẩn bất ngờ, nhưng nước đi an toàn đến mức khó hiểu này đang khiến King's Cup năm nay giảm nhiệt thê thảm.  Giải đấu dự kiến diễn ra tại Sisaket từ ngày 9 đến 17/11.
Theo anh em, Thái Lan sợ cố tình né ĐTVN hay thực sự bí khách mời đến mức phải mời bằng Brunei để kiếm thêm điểm.

snippet.description:

❤️ इस कहानी से सीख मिलती है: इंसान की पहचान उसके कपड़ों, पैसे या पद से नहीं, बल्कि उसके कर्मों और व्यवहार से होती है। किसी गरीब का अपमान कभी मत कीजिए, क्योंकि हर इंसान सम्मान का हकदार है।

अगर आपको हमारी भावनात्मक और प्रेरणादायक कहानी पसंद आए, तो वीडियो को LIKE करें, चैनल को SUBSCRIBE करें और अपने दोस्तों के साथ SHARE जरूर करें।

snippet.title: “Your brother was a patriotic public servant”: Jack Smith to Sen. Darline Graham on a gag order
snippet.description:
At the Senate Judiciary Committee's Sept. 29, 2026 hearing, Sen. Darline Graham (R-S.C.) said Jack Smith had told a federal judge that her brother, the late Sen. Lindsey Graham, a sitting senator and a chairman of the committee, had "the potential to destroy evidence, intimidate witnesses, and cause serious jeopardy" to the investigation, and asked whether Smith believed he would destroy evidence that was not in his possession. Smith: "No, I believe your brother was a patriotic public servant. He was not a target of our investigation. And in fact, he likely would have been a witness in our case. Your brother investigated the claims that Donald Trump was making. He found them to be false." Graham asked why the gag order said disclosure would result in destruction of or tampering with evidence. Smith: "Because disclosure of that subpoena could result in Donald Trump attempting to intimidate witnesses as he had before and after. We had an ample basis for that."

The record: Sen. Lindsey Graham died in July 2026 and his sister was appointed to his seat. In 2023, court orders barred phone companies from telling lawmakers about subpoenas of their call records. Smith's lawyers have said the subpoena sought toll records, information that does not include the contents of calls, of eight senators and one House member, and that the step followed Justice Department procedures, including approval from the Public Integrity Section. The courts' administrative office has told Sen. Grassley that the chief judge who signed the orders would likely have been unaware that the numbers belonged to lawmakers; Republican senators say the lawmakers should have been told.

Sources: Senate Judiciary Committee hearing video and page, Sept. 29, 2026; letter from Smith's lawyers to Sen. Grassley, Oct. 21, 2025; Fox News, Dec. 3, 2025; NPR, July 12, 2026; Deseret News, July 14, 2026.

Source: Senate Judiciary Committee, Sept. 29, 2026, "Oversight of Jack Smith's Abuse of Authority and the Targeting of Republicans and Related Matters" (at 3:41:28).

--------------------------------------------------------------------
The show is inspired from the famous humorous column 'Duniya Ne Undha Chasma' written by the eminent Gujarati writer Mr. Tarak Mehta. The show predominantly - revolves around 'Jethalal' who is an uneducated Gujarati businessman. Your 'Taarak Mehta', is his neighbor. Jethalaal's family includes his simpleton wife 'Daya Ben' and a mischievous son 'Tapu'. Tapu is a menace and a constant source of trouble to all the members of Gokuldham. They have often warned 'Jethalal' to reform 'Tapu' or else be prepared to leave the premises. Lost hopes of being heard by his son push Jethalal' to call his father 'Champaklal' from the village. This was his great idea of leashing some control over the mischievous Tapu. snippet.title: Did Trump and Musk ‘betray’ Zelensky? | BBC News
snippet.description:
President Zelensky has said he feels "betrayed" by President Trump and the US. 
 
He believes access to Elon Musk's Starlink Starshield system, which is critical to Ukraine's fight against Russia, was limited. Ukraine said systems have now been restored.
 
But - just how reliant Ukraine and others are on Elon Musk's technology? And are there any alternatives? 
 
In this video...

1:39 – What is Starlink
2:16 – What is Starshield

4:27 – What has Elon Musk said
5:26 – Has the Pentagon responded
6:16 – Are there alternatives to Starlink
7:59 – Is Europe too reliant on US tech
